title: You Are Already a Magician
visualThesis: The magician's path is a progressive realization that the finite self is continuous with infinite awareness — each practice reveals this identity rather than constructing it.

continuitySystems.meaning: Infinite awareness, Nuit, the sun, the All — centerless, unbounded, always present.
continuitySystems.treatment: A gold-white radial field that fills frame or appears as a soft glow behind the action. Never completely absent once introduced.

continuitySystems.meaning: The finite self, Hadit, the aspirant — a point of concentrated awareness that can contract, expand, or dissolve.
continuitySystems.treatment: A small crimson or indigo node that moves through the field. Can be encircled, caged, or opened.

continuitySystems.meaning: The practices — four limbs of yoga plus ritual theurgy. Enclosing structures that can relax or open.
continuitySystems.treatment: Five curved arcs around the local point. They tighten during practice descriptions and relax during recognition.

continuitySystems.meaning: The rhythmic heartbeat of the Work — solar cycle, breath cycle, life force.
continuitySystems.treatment: A pulsing radial wave or expanding ring at the boundary of the luminous field.

captionPolicy: Narration carries the prose. Footer shows title, subtitle, term and Devanagari where applicable.

shots.title: Magic Is Will
shots.subtitle: Change in conformity with will.
shots.visualRationale: The field is the All. The point is the self.

shots.title: Systematic Discipline
shots.subtitle: Four limbs and theurgy.
shots.visualRationale: Four limbs plus theurgy are five structures.

shots.title: Practice Begins With the Sun
shots.subtitle: Solar adoration as spiritual presence.
shots.visualRationale: The sun is the center. Four stations. One day.

shots.title: Three Functions
shots.subtitle: Mnemonic, relational, theurgic.
shots.visualRationale: Three functions build on each other: remember, relate, draw force.

shots.title: The Four Adorations
shots.subtitle: The sun becomes a clock.
shots.visualRationale: The four adorations are the structure of sacred time.

shots.title: The Fourfold Training
shots.subtitle: Asana, pranayama, dharana, dhyana.
shots.visualRationale: Four limbs of training — each is a layer of structure around the self.

shots.title: The Foundation
shots.subtitle: Boring, physical, non-negotiable.
shots.visualRationale: The body mastered before will acts.

shots.title: Devotion as Method
shots.subtitle: Constant mindfulness of the Beloved.
shots.visualRationale: The self directs all attention toward the Beloved.

shots.title: Love as Force
shots.subtitle: Love transforms the lover into the beloved.
shots.visualRationale: Love as directed energy — the self becomes what it contemplates.

shots.title: The Cake of Light
shots.subtitle: The magician consecrates the offering.
shots.visualRationale: The sun essence enters the self — the offering is the life-force itself.

shots.title: Carrying the Sun
shots.subtitle: Continuity through the dark.
shots.visualRationale: The point carries the light when the field is absent — the magician becomes the vessel.

shots.title: The Circle and the Point
shots.subtitle: Nuit and Hadit.
shots.visualRationale: The circle is infinite space. The point is concentrated awareness.

shots.title: The Union
shots.subtitle: You are the union of space and point.
shots.continuityObject: point expands into field; arcs release
shots.visualRationale: The recognition: the point and field are not two. This is the Great Work realized.
